name: uplift-plane-page
description: Write or convert documents into Plane pages that non-developers can actually read: plain-language headings with technical detail underneath, no arrow/em-dash shorthand, no Obsidian wikilinks, mermaid rendered to images. Includes a checker, a mermaid-to-PNG renderer (Thai fonts), and a publisher for self-hosted Plane that also guards against the live-server overwrite trap.
